_comment: Shared cross-language test vectors for the WorldView MCP capability token (H19.3.2). Both the JARVIS Python minter (agents/core/security/worldview_mcp.py, tested in tests/test_worldview_mcp_capability.py) AND the MCP server's TS implementation (worldview/mcp/src/auth.ts, tested in worldview/mcp/test/capabilityVectors.test.ts) assert that minting these claims produces the exact token AND that verifying the token returns the claims. If either side's format drifts, CI fails — so the two security implementations can never silently diverge.
